# <!--name-->Changelog comment<!--/name-->
<!--description-->
Downloads the changelog-decision artifact from the triggering workflow run and posts or updates the sticky changelog PR comment. Safe to call even when no artifact was uploaded — the command succeeds with no action taken. Always comments on the newest completed run of the triggering workflow for the same PR branch, whichever run triggered the job, so a stale decision cannot overwrite a newer one and a cancelled job cannot leave the newest one unposted. With current-run, it reads the artifact from the current run instead.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs
<!--inputs-->
| Name           | Description                                                                                                                                                     | Required | Default               |
|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|-----------------------|
| `github-token` | GitHub token with pull-requests: write                                                                                                                          | `false`  | `${{ github.token }}` |
| `current-run`  | Read the changelog-decision artifact from the current run instead of the triggering workflow run. Use it in a job that needs the job that uploads the artifact. | `false`  | `false`               |
<!--/inputs-->
